verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026 under the rule that level A needs the instrument's own text or an official register. Re-read the framework PDF, version 2.0 dated December 2025 (digitalpolicy.gov.hk, stored 11 Oct 2026, unchanged on 18 Oct 2026), and the Digital Policy Office's page 'AI and Data Ethics' that presents it and links the PDF (same dates). The PDF confirms the title, the issuer, the version and its date, the amendment history from version 1.1 (June 2023) and the content of the summary. Neither the PDF nor the page dates the first version: date_published, the year 2021, rests on a speech by the Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry of 30 Oct 2025 on the bureau's site (itib.gov.hk, stored again in this run on 18 Oct 2026), which says the framework was 'first introduced in 2021' and updated in 2023. A speech is an announcement, so the date counts as alt-official and the record is level B until the framework's first version or an official record of its issue is stored.

judgment.status_reasoning: The DPO page presents the framework and links version 2.0 of December 2025, the latest entry of the amendment history. It is guidance with principles, practices and an assessment template, offered for general reference to other organisations; nothing stored shows a later version or a withdrawal. 'Published (non-binding, current)' and 'Non-binding' stand.
judgment.date_reasoning: The PDF's amendment history begins with version 1.1 in June 2023, and neither the PDF nor the DPO page dates the first version. The Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry's speech of 30 Oct 2025, stored in this run, says the framework was 'first introduced in 2021'; it gives only the year, so the value stays 2021. A speech is an announcement, so the date counts as alt-official and the record computes level B.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A government ethical AI framework with principles, governance and an impact assessment for AI projects; in scope with no note.
